entities.name: Jakub Jeřábek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jakub Jeřábek is a Czech professional ice hockey defenseman for HC Oceláři Třinec in the Czech Extraliga (ELH). Originally undrafted by teams in the National Hockey League (NHL), Jeřábek has previously played for the Montreal Canadiens, Washington Capitals, and St. Louis Blues.
